name: FCX/NEM Pair Trade — Ratio Z-Score Mean Reversion
description: Pairs trade: long FCX / short NEM when the FCX/NEM price ratio 252-day rolling z-score crosses below -2.0. Hold for up to 63 trading days. Exit early if the ratio return from entry falls below -15% (stop loss). Only one position open at a time — new signals are ignored while a trade is active. Each leg sized at 50% of equity for equal dollar exposure.
source:
# FCX/NEM Pair Trade — Ratio Z-Score Mean Reversion
#
# Signal: FCX/NEM price ratio 252-day rolling z-score crosses below -2.0
#         (ratio is cheap → long FCX, short NEM)
# Hold:   Up to 63 trading days
# Stop:   Exit if ratio return from entry < -15%
# Rule:   One position at a time — ignore new signals while in a trade
#
# Both FCX and NEM are in assets[]. Each context loads the other leg via
# reference_stocks so the same ratio signal drives both legs simultaneously.
# FCX context → long entry. NEM context → short entry.

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Load the other leg in each asset context:
#   FCX context: reference_stocks('NEM') gives NEM close
#   NEM context: reference_stocks('FCX') gives FCX close
# The ratio is always FCX / NEM regardless of which context we're in.
fcx_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()

# FCX close and NEM close, resolved per-context:
#   In FCX context: fcx_close = src.c, nem_close = nem_ref.c
#   In NEM context: fcx_close = fcx_ref.c, nem_close = src.c
# We compute the ratio identically in both contexts.
fcx_close = ffill(fcx_ref.c)
nem_close = ffill(nem_ref.c)

# --- Ratio & Z-Score ---
# FCX/NEM price ratio
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close

# 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio
ratio_zscore = zscore(window=252)(ratio)

# Entry signal: z-score crosses below -2.0 (ratio is historically cheap)
# This is a pulse (one bar) — we persist it with hold_until
entry_pulse = crossunder(ratio_zscore, -2.0)

# --- One-Position-At-A-Time Gate ---
# Capture ratio at entry for stop loss calculation
# We need entry_ratio before defining in_trade, so we use the pulse directly.
# valuewhen(occurrence=0) holds the ratio value from the most recent entry bar.
entry_ratio = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(entry_pulse, ratio)

# Ratio return from entry (negative = ratio has fallen since entry)
ratio_return_from_entry = (ratio - entry_ratio) / entry_ratio

# --- Exit Conditions ---
# Time exit: 63 trading days elapsed since entry pulse
bars_in_trade = coalesce(barssince()(entry_pulse), 9999)
time_exit = bars_in_trade >= 63

# Stop loss: ratio has fallen 15% or more from entry level
stop_exit = ratio_return_from_entry < -0.15

# Combined exit: first triggered wins
exit_signal = time_exit or stop_exit

# --- Signal State Machine ---
# hold_until latches True on entry_pulse, releases on exit_signal.
# While in_trade=True, new entry_pulses are gated out → one position at a time.
in_trade = hold_until()(enter=entry_pulse, exit=exit_signal)

# Gate new entries: only enter if not already in a trade
gated_entry = entry_pulse and not in_trade

# Re-latch with gated entry for clean state (prevents re-entry mid-trade)
held_signal = hold_until()(enter=gated_entry, exit=exit_signal)

# --- Executors ---
# FCX context: go LONG when signal fires, exit when exit_signal fires
# NEM context: go SHORT when signal fires, exit when exit_signal fires
# We wire exit as the opposing direction to close the position flat.
# long_and_short_zone with short_entry=exit wires a flat close for FCX (long leg).
# For NEM (short leg), long_entry=exit closes the short.
# Since both assets share the same signal logic, we use:
#   long_entry=held_signal  → FCX goes long, NEM goes long (wrong for NEM)
# Instead, we use the zone differently per leg:
#   FCX: long_entry=held_signal, short_entry=exit_signal (close long → flat)
#   NEM: short_entry=held_signal, long_entry=exit_signal (close short → flat)
# EpochScript runs this code identically for both assets, so we need a way
# to differentiate. We use is_asset_ref() to detect which context we're in.

is_nem = is_asset_ref(ticker='NEM-Stocks')

# Long entry: active for FCX (not NEM), exit for NEM
long_entry_signal = (held_signal and not is_nem) or (exit_signal and is_nem)

# Short entry: active for NEM (not FCX), exit for FCX
short_entry_signal = (held_signal and is_nem) or (exit_signal and not is_nem)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry_signal, short_entry=short_entry_signal)

# Equal dollar sizing: 50% per leg
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)

# --- Event Markers ---
# Mark trade entries (z-score crossunder below -2.0, not already in trade)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Pair Trade Entry',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX/NEM Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='NEM Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ratio_zscore, ratio, fcx_close, nem_close, gated_entry)

# Mark exits — both time-based and stop-loss
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Pair Trade Exit',
        icon=Icon.FlagIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Exit Type', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Bars Held', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ratio_return_from_entry, 'Stop' if stop_exit else 'Time', bars_in_trade, exit_signal and in_trade)
